business: Nexio CRM (a cloud CRM for small Uzbek companies)
by_segment: Sales manager at a growing company
why_not: I do not know a single company that uses it, and they say only 1 to 5 firms pay today. I would not move my clients out of Excel and Telegram into something with no references, and $29 a month is real money on my income when a free tier or my current setup works.

I run everything from Telegram and a notebook and it works. I have never used a CRM, and $29 a month is a big bite out of what I earn. I don't know anyone who uses this, so I'm not paying for an unknown tool.
My Excel works and I know every cell of it. $29 a month is real money for me and I would still have to retrain my people, even if they move the data.
My Excel works and I am proud of it. I do not want to move all my clients and debts to a new system and retrain my people for something I do not need yet.
I make about $500 a month and $29 is a big piece of that, when Bitrix24 has a free plan. I run my shop on Telegram and a notebook and it works well enough.
I earn about $1,200 a month and run everything from Telegram and a notebook, so $29 for a tool I have never used is a real bite. Bitrix24 has a free plan, so I would try that first.
